intro_heading: Security for Every Layer, Engineered to Work Together
intro_paragraphs:
Octel Networks brings endpoint, network, identity, cloud, email and data security together into one coordinated defense architecture, delivered on established platforms from Trend AI, Trellix, Sophos and CrowdStrike. Each layer is designed around how your users, applications and workloads actually operate, so protection follows the business wherever it extends.

Most organizations add security tools one incident at a time, leaving isolated alerts and gaps between them. We start with an assessment of your real exposure and connect the controls that matter, so threats are detected earlier, understood in context and contained faster, instead of relying on a single defense that ransomware, credential theft or AI-assisted phishing can bypass.
portfolio_subtitle: Connected protection across every attack surface, not a stack of separate tools
portfolio_cards:
ri-shield-check-line | Endpoint, EDR & XDR | Protection for desktops, laptops and servers combines malware and ransomware defense with behavioral visibility. EDR and XDR correlate endpoint activity with wider signals, helping teams separate isolated events from coordinated attacks and respond with context.
ri-shield-keyhole-line | Network Security & Zero Trust | Next-generation firewalls, intrusion prevention, secure VPN and segmentation control every connection. Zero Trust and ZTNA replace implicit trust with continuous checks on identity, device posture and access context before any application is reached.
ri-mail-lock-line | Email, Data & Identity Protection | Phishing, malicious links and weaponized attachments are stopped before they reach users. Data discovery and DLP show where sensitive information lives and moves, while identity security protects privileged access and detects credential-based attacks.

intro_heading: Close the Gap Between Endpoint and Network

Modern attacks rarely stay on one device or one security layer. A phishing email can lead to a compromised endpoint, stolen credentials and lateral movement across the network. Octel Networks connects endpoint protection with network security, from EDR and XDR to next-generation firewalls, UTM and secure VPN, so both layers see the same threat.

Security software is only as strong as its deployment and operations. We assess the current environment, design the right architecture, migrate cleanly from legacy antivirus and fragmented tools, and integrate the platforms with SOC, NOC and managed detection and response, so a technology purchase becomes an operating capability.

intro_heading: IT Support as One Continuum, Not Separate Engagements
intro_paragraphs:
Technology infrastructure needs more than a one-time deployment — it needs planning before it's built and support after it's live. Octel Networks provides end-to-end IT services covering consulting, project execution, and day-to-day facility management, giving organizations a single team accountable across the full lifecycle.

Most organizations plan technology projects with one team, implement them with another, and support them with a third, losing context and accountability at every handoff. We stay involved from an honest assessment of your environment, through coordinating vendors and OEMs during implementation, to ongoing monitoring and SLA-based support once systems are live.

intro_heading: One Managed Environment for an Entire Property
intro_paragraphs:
A mall runs on more connections than any single tenant sees — visitors, retailers, facility teams, and security systems all depending on the same underlying network. Octel Networks manages the internet, network, Wi-Fi, and telephony infrastructure that ties an entire property together, so every stakeholder gets consistent connectivity without managing it themselves.

Most shopping malls end up with internet, tenant connections, and guest Wi-Fi installed independently over time, with no shared visibility across any of it. We manage mall infrastructure as one connected environment from the start, with internet redundancy, network segmentation, and centralized monitoring so issues are caught before tenants or visitors notice them.
portfolio_subtitle: Internet, Wi-Fi, telephony, and segmentation engineered to work together across an entire property
portfolio_cards:
ri-global-line | Internet & Network Management | Bandwidth management, redundancy, and failovers keep connectivity dependable, with switches, routers, and access points monitored centrally.
ri-wifi-line | Mall-Wide & Guest Wi-Fi | High-density Wi-Fi engineered for food courts, common areas, and parking, with secure, scalable guest access separate from operational traffic.
ri-node-tree | Tenant Connectivity & Segmentation | Dedicated, segmented connectivity for every outlet, keeping tenant, guest, administrative, security, and IoT traffic properly isolated.
ri-phone-line | IP Telephony & Multi-Location Connectivity | Extensions, IP-PBX, and intercom systems connect security desks, facility teams, and administrative staff across the property.
